group.label: Memoirs · The Shadow That Signals Victory

lines.text: Once again, we headed out to the battlefield today. Once again, the Raptures' attacks were relentless, and countless Nikkes fell. Once again, I found myself facing death. I figured I'd been lucky enough to survive last time, but there was no escaping it this time.

Then, a massive shadow fell over me once again. This time, several figures descended from the ship. As soon as they did, I heard someone shout something. What'd they say? Something like, "We're saved!"
The ones who'd gotten off the ship swept the battlefield in an instant, finally lifting the shadow of death from me. I was so happy to survive that I bawled.
It had been them this whole time, the ones standing on that shadow.
The Goddesses of Victory. Humanity's hope.
From that day on, I started to hope for the massive shadow to appear over me once again on the battlefield.
